text:
Gate closed: docs up to date for v0.3 layout migration

- README.md describes the new install + scaffold flow (LERNIE_HOME,
  harness root subdirs, lernie new under <harness-root>/conversations/,
  no .agent/ examples) — updated in bl-66da's PR.
- AGENTS.md is process-only (task tracking + terminology discipline);
  no layout content to update.
- src/, crates/, template/, README.md, AGENTS.md grep clean for
  current-state references to .agent/, exchanges/, invocations/,
  ex/<, inv/<. Historical mentions in ARCH §12 milestones excepted
  per the gate spec.
- ARCH/PRINCIPLES/TAXONOMY were pinned at abfe713; no drift
  introduced by phase work since.
